message.content: {"reason": "The trusted accuracy of 0.740 sits below what the feature set should support because only 3 of 21 discrete fields reach the embedding tables and the frequency answers' missingness is aliased into the numeric zero used for 'never' (the featurizer applies fillna(0) after NaN→float), so 'not answered' and 'never' are indistinguishable. The prior successful runs show the load-bearing pieces are the stateful leakage-safe feature engineer, categorical metadata persisted in the bundle, and native explicit category indices — not new backbones — so the highest-leverage place to apply the initial plan's embedding extension is the featurizer (explicit per-field category codes with a reserved missing token and unknown index), the model (embeddings for every discrete field), and the bundle/CV plumbing that must persist vocabularies and map unseen predict-time categories to unknown without refitting.", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "model_design", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Extend CouponFeatureEngineer so every discrete raw field gets a dedicated categorical code column (suffix '_le') in addition to the existing ordinal/numeric column: temperature, time, coupon, expiration, gender, age, maritalStatus, has_children, education, occupation, income, Bar, CoffeeHouse, CarryAway, RestaurantLessThan20, Restaurant20To50, toCoupon_GEQ5min/15min/25min, direction_same, direction_opp. WHY: today categorical_cols is only ['coupon','occupation','maritalStatus'] and the FREQ_COLS ordinals fillna->0 collide 'never' with unanswered, so the network cannot represent the ~70-127 missing frequency responses as their own signal. HOW: add CAT_FIELDS list and MISSING_TOKEN='__missing__', build a normalization helper _cat_key(series) that lowercases/strips and maps NaN/empty to MISSING_TOKEN before astype(str); in fit(), build label_maps[col] = {token: i for i,token in enumerate(sorted(tokens))} per field using TRAIN rows only; in transform(), emit out[col+'_le'] = tokens.map(self.label_maps[col]).fillna(-1).astype(int) so unseen predict-time tokens and genuinely absent values fall to -1 (the reserved unknown index consumed by _shift_cat) while __missing__ is a real fitted category with its own non-negative index; also add binary '<col>_missing' indicators for the five FREQ_COLS (and temperature) so the numeric path can no longer alias never/missing. Preserve class name, fit/fit_transform/transform signatures, feature_names, COMBO_COLS, categorical_cols (now the extended list), and the existing engineered columns so downstream code and the persisted bundle stay compatible.", "model_design": "WHAT: Allow CouponEmbeddingNet to embed every '_le' column, not just three. WHY: with the featurizer emitting all 21 discrete fields, the embedding tables give free non-monotonic vectors plus a distinct unknown vector, which is exactly the mechanism the initial plan expects to deliver +0.3-0.8pp; keeping the ordinal numeric columns leaves ordering information for age/income/education/distance intact. HOW: keep split_feature_columns using CAT_SUFFIX='_le' so cardinalities come from the same _shift_cat (+1) convention — after shift, unknown/-1 maps to index 0 and fitted categories to 1..K, giving cards = K+1 with a guaranteed slot for unknown; leave the existing embedding_dim(card, max_dim=16) formula, emb_dropout=0.05, nn.Embedding init N(0,0.05), hidden_dims=(256,128), ResidualMLPBlock stack, BatchNorm/GELU trunk, and head untouched; no changes to CouponEmbeddingNet.__init__ signature, forward(x_cat, x_num), ModelConfig defaults (dropout 0.25, lr 3e-3, weight_decay 1e-4, batch 256, label_smoothing 0.03, grad_clip 1.0), build_model/build_train_components, build_criterion, build_optimizer, or build_scheduler; rely on build_optimizer's existing ndim<=1/'embedding' rule so the new embedding tables stay in the no-decay group.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Persist the extended vocabularies/cardinalities and verify the unknown-index path end-to-end without touching the training recipe. WHY: historical wins came from a single bundle carrying feature order plus categorical metadata, and the new per-field label_maps must be reloaded verbatim at predict time so unseen categories map to the reserved unknown index instead of being refit; the initial plan requires semantics unchanged (seed 42, 5-fold StratifiedKFold shuffle random_state=42, CrossEntropyLoss label_smoothing=0.03, AdamW lr 3e-3/wd 1e-4, OneCycleLR, batch 256, max_epochs=20 CV and production, 3-seed ensemble, exactly row_id,prediction mapped back to original labels). HOW: _prepare_fold already reindexes to fe.feature_names and _shift_cat(cat, None) derives cards from train-only shifted codes — confirm cards length equals the extended cat_cols and that _shift_cat clips to [0, card-1], so a training fold lacking a category present in validation still gets that category clipped into the unknown slot rather than shifting the table; _save_bundle already pickles fe (carrying label_maps) plus feature_names/cat_cols/num_cols/cards/label_map, so no new keys are needed, only assert len(cards)==len(cat_cols) and add a reload smoke check that fe.transform on the predict frame yields -1 → 0 for unseen tokens; leave extract of best_epochs/median production epochs, 3-seed _fit_full calls, _ensemble_proba softmax averaging, and run_predict's argmax+label_map mapping with fresh-process _load_bundle unchanged."}}

We need to output JSON with reason, module array, plan object matching module keys.

The initial plan's core direction: extend entity embeddings to all discrete raw features (all categorical fields), with explicit missing/unknown index, fit on training only, persist vocabularies, map unseen to unknown. Keep everything else unchanged.

Modules: data_processing_and_feature_engineering (build explicit categorical code columns for all discrete fields, including missing category, fit on train, persist), model_design (add embeddings for all categoricals, cardinalities, unknown index), training_evaluation (persist card/vocab in bundle, ensure predict maps unseen to unknown, keep CV/ensemble config unchanged). Possibly also training_evaluation for cardinality persistence and interface.

Historical: success came from merged single script, stateful leakage-safe feature engineer, native categorical handling, persisted feature order/categorical metadata in bundle. So refine: add a dedicated categorical code column per discrete raw field (suffix like _cat or _le with unknown index 0), fit vocab only on training, store vocab maps and cardinalities in fe, use in bundle. Model: embeddings for all those columns, card = len(vocab)+1 (unknown at 0 or last). Keep numeric ordinal columns unchanged (retain ordinal info), keep missing indicator columns so "never" vs missing distinct.

Note current fe.categorical_cols = ["coupon","occupation","maritalStatus"], label_maps fillna(-1), _shift_cat shifts +1. We should extend categorical_cols to all discrete fields: temperature, time, coupon, expiration, gender, age, maritalStatus, has_children, education, occupation, income, Bar, CoffeeHouse, CarryAway, RestaurantLessThan20, Restaurant20To50, toCoupon_GEQ5min/15/25, direction_same, direction_opp. Actually toCoupon_GEQ5min has 1 distinct (constant) - embedding dim min 2, cardinality 1+1=2 ok.

Missing handling: use explicit token for NaN/missing (e.g., "__NA__") before mapping, and reserve index 0 for unknown; vocab sorted starting at 1.

Implementation detail: In fe, for each field in CAT_FIELDS (new list), compute normalized key string: _sl + fillna token, e.g., series.fillna("__na__"). Fit vocab from train unique → map to 1..K, unknown 0. Persist label_maps (already persisted via fe object pickled by torch.save of fe). Cardinality = len(vocab)+1.

Model: split_feature_columns uses CAT_SUFFIX "_le" — extend so every discrete field has _le column. num columns remain ordinal + engineered. Embedding cardinalities computed via _shift_cat on _le columns: with -1 never used (since 0 is unknown), _shift_cat +1 gives 1..K+1; careful: _shift_cat maps nan→-1 then +1 →0, and values 0→1. So cards = max+1. If we use unknown=0 and vocab 1..K, then shifted = value+1 giving 1..K+1, card = K+2. That's fine but need consistency. Better: keep current _shift_cat (+1 shift) and define _le column as vocab index starting at 0 for unknown? Current: label map values i from 0..K-1, fillna -1 → _shift_cat +1 → unknown becomes 0, known become 1..K, card K+1. That's already correct: fillna(-1) for unseen/NaN gives shifted 0 = unknown index. So just extend categorical_cols and ensure missing gets -1 not merged with "never". Currently _s(_safe_col) astype(str) on NaN yields 'nan' string, and fit includes 'nan' as a category if present — that's actually distinct from "never". Hmm: _s(series) = astype(str).str.strip(); NaN → 'nan'. So fit would create category 'nan' distinct from 'never'. But mapping at transform: NaN → 'nan' → mapped to its own index. So missingness is already distinct in the 3 embedded fields. Issue is only that these fields aren't embedded at all. But to be robust, explicitly use a MISSING_TOKEN = "__missing__" for null values before astype(str), so consistent, and reserve UNK for unseen at predict.

Also keep ordinal numeric columns with NaN→0 currently (collides with never). Add explicit missing indicators for the 5 freq columns + temperature maybe. Add `col_missing` binary flags. That directly addresses the collision, and ensures "never" vs missing distinct in numeric path too.

Plan modules: all three.

Plan text each 2-5 sentences with what/why/how/interface.

Keep config unchanged: seed 42, StratifiedKFold 5 shuffle, CE label_smoothing 0.03, AdamW lr 3e-3 wd 1e-4, OneCycleLR, batch 256, 20 epochs CV/prod, grad clip 1.0, hidden (256,128), dropout 0.25, emb dropout 0.05, 3-seed ensemble, output contract.

Note: new embedding columns increase n_cat from 3 to 21; emb_max_dim 16 default; cardinality small. Should also maybe reduce emb dim? Keep embedding_dim formula (max 16, min 2). For occupation 25 → ~ 1.6*25^0.56 ≈ 1.6*6.2≈9.9 →10. Fine.

Careful with BatchNorm1d on numeric with 2 threads — fine.

Write reason sentence.

Output JSON only.
